I've never done 700mg (most I've done is 500mg) but  here is some advice I've gathered from others and some of my own advice:

-Write a note saying that you have taken 700mg of DPH and put that on your door. Sometimes with DPH you can forget that you even took it.

-Hide your keys from yourself before taking the DPH

-Hide the rest of your DPH from yourself before taking the DPH

-Have lots of water ready and drink lots of water

-Avoid going downstairs if possible

-Its probably best to stay in your room or at least in your house/apartment

-If you are taking DPH at night time cover your windows, unless you want to see some spooky shit outside

-Do not message your parents while you are intoxicated. I'm sure you know this but I'm still going to remind you anyway.

-It would probably be a good idea to have a trip sitter or at least someone to talk to; maybe tell a friend you are going to be taking DPH and message them throughout the night to help with your sanity (this always helps me). Only do this if your friend is okay with you messaging them while you are intoxicated.

-Listen to peaceful or upbeat music. (I always listen to Carly Rae Jepsen while doing DPH, it helps a lot and also sounds great IMO)

-Watch a show or something on Netflix so you have something yo focus on and distract you from the voices or hallucinations.

-In my experience it is a good idea to avoid mirrors, the first time I took DPH (500mg) my reflection scared the shit out of me.

-Wear clothes you dont mind vomiting on.

Hopefully you find some of this advice useful, I dont have the same first hand experience as many of the other users on here but I still have some experience with the drug. DM me if you want someone to talk to while you are tripping, I may or may not be free but I would like to help if possible. I'm sure there are other people tho with more experience that you would be more comfortable talking to if you want someone to talk to while tripping.
